title: Trigonometry and rotations
summary: On a circle of radius one, turn counterclockwise through angle $\theta$ from the point $(1,0)$.

title: Matrix powers and functions
summary: For a square matrix $A$, $A^2=AA$ and $A^3=AAA$; these are [row-by-column matrix products](/definitions/matrix-multiplication/), not entrywise powers.

title: Vector norms, operator norms, and conditioning
summary: For a complex vector $v=(v_0,\ldots,v_{D-1})^T$, its Euclidean norm is $\|v\|=\sqrt{\sum_j|v_j|^2}$.
